description: This file defines a node event system in Go, including event types, data structures, publisher functions, an event bus with subscription management, filtering and deduplication mechanisms, and helper methods for broadcasting node status-related events. It manages node lifecycle events such as online/offline, status updates, health changes, state transitions, and system snapshots, facilitating communication within a distributed system.

classes.name: NodeEvent
classes.description: Represents a node state change event with type, node identifier, status, timestamp, data payload, and optional fields for enhanced status tracking.

classes.name: NodeEventBus
classes.description: Manages subscription and broadcasting of node events to multiple subscribers, with thread-safe operations, filtering, and deduplication to prevent spam and duplicate events.

methods.name: NewNodeEventBus
methods.description: Creates a new instance of NodeEventBus.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a subscriber channel to receive node events.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber channel.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all active subscribers with filtering for spam and duplicates.

methods.name: GetSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of subscribers.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a NodeEvent to JSON string.

methods.name: PublishNodeOnline
methods.description: Publishes a node online event.

methods.name: PublishNodeOffline

methods.name: PublishNodeHeartbeat
